title: Possible a PGP private key block in source
description: A string shaped like a PGP private key block was found in source. Anyone with repository access can try it until it is revoked. Shape-only: this does not prove the credential is live.
remediation: Revoke the value in the provider console, audit its use, and replace it with a minimally scoped credential stored outside version control.
limitation: Shape-only: matches the documented prefix and length family, which cannot prove a live credential.

tests.line: # audit: key = "-----BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK-----" present
